description: The open-source TypeScript SDK for AI agents with self-improving memory and production fundamentals built in.
rules: Eidentic is a TypeScript SDK published on npm as `eidentic` (umbrella) and `@eidentic/*` (32 packages). Always use the TypeScript API and ESM imports.
Construct an agent with `new Agent({ id, model, store })`; wrap any AI SDK provider via `new AIModel(provider(modelId))`.
Use `@eidentic/libsql` (LibsqlStore, pure-JS, no native addon) for Next.js/serverless; `@eidentic/sqlite` (SqliteStore) for Node/Bun.
`agent.query(input, { sessionId })` returns an async generator of StreamEvents; text deltas are `ev.type === 'stream.delta'` carrying `ev.delta.text`; the terminal event is `ev.type === 'result'`.
Memory: `new Memory({ store, vector, embedder, graph })` — four tiers (lexical+vector recall, self-editing blocks, temporal knowledge graph, consolidation).

Next.js: `export const POST = withEidentic(agent)` from `@eidentic/nextjs`. React: `useEidenticStream(endpoint)` from `@eidentic/react`. Server: `createServer({ agents })` + `serveNode(app, { port })` from `@eidentic/server`.
The umbrella package `eidentic` re-exports core+types+model+sqlite+memory; install adapters (`@eidentic/server`, `@eidentic/workflow`, etc.) separately as needed.
